method: Read-only mission-assurance; no target execution or repair.

sources.body: Advancing an upstream task does not fence its existing receipt here. For example, after sealing CMAD1 at revision 1 and assigning CMAD1 revision 2, a currently authorized CMAD2 submission can still use the revision-1 predecessor: these checks only compare policy/epoch and artifact bytes, and neither discovery nor assignment advancement invalidates that receipt. This lets downstream stages seal against superseded task evidence. Check each ancestor's recorded principal/revision against its current host_tasks assignment before accepting it.

Resolving the path here removes symlink components before the guarded reader can reject them. An artifact replaced by an in-scope symlink is rejected by `digest_file(original_path, root)`, but `source_changed` returns `True`; a dangling in-scope symlink also returns `True`. Consequently, reopening can accept these paths and persist invalidations despite the newly enforced symlink-denial policy. Pass the original path to the guarded reader and recognize missing-source drift only when its underlying failure is `FileNotFoundError`, preserving scope denials for symlinks.

expected: Before accepting an ancestor receipt, current host_tasks principal and revision equal immutable receipt principal/revision for every chain ancestor.
Checks occur inside the existing shared host transaction and persist no rewritten history or partial downstream effects on denial.
Immediate and nonimmediate revision change, missing assignment, principal reassignment and persisted restart deny; unchanged assignments and unrelated task changes remain valid.
Matched baseline failure and candidate correction are source-bound; no invented ancestor migration or implicit recovery authority.
Original source path reaches the guarded reader; no resolve/normalization removes forbidden components before validation.
Only genuine missing-source FileNotFoundError under valid root classifies as drift; symlink, dangling link, parent traversal and invalid root refusals propagate.
Explicitly listed changes and discovered omitted changes enforce the same policy and earliest owner.
A changed earlier source does not mask forbidden later evidence; immutable history and mutation rollback preserved.
Unchanged source=false, changed regular source=true and genuine missing source=true controls preserve supported recovery.
